name: Cost Plus World Market - Stockton CA Distribution Center

fieldNotes.truckGate: A named 'Cost Plus World Market Truck Gate' business exists at 1735 Zephyr St per Waze, with managed hours (Mon-Sat 07:00-16:00). The entire property is enclosed by a continuous block/concrete perimeter wall plus hedge along Zephyr St and chain-link fence around the north and south trailer yards. Truck gate confirmed by listing; treated as true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth was visible in any Street View pano along Zephyr St (continuous wall), nor at the open office driveway on the east side. No 1-3-vehicle-footprint booth structure identified at any entrance - low confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because a controlled/named truck gate exists but no guard shack could be confirmed visually - implies kiosk/call-box/app check-in. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors run along both the long north face (trailers backed in, visible at z19-20) and the long south face (trailers along the rail line). Combined estimate ~90 doors across the ~250m+ building faces - clearly the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on opposite (north and south) faces of the building, suggesting separate ship/receive clusters. Medium confidence - could also be one continuous receiving operation.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots: angled-stall drop yard north and NE of the building, plus a very large drop yard south of the rail line packed with rows of parked trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail spur runs along the entire south face of the building between the dock apron and the south drop yard.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~240 trailers counted across the north drop yard, NE angled stalls, and the large south drop yard - approximate honest estimate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Could not positively count gate lanes - estimate 1 in / 1 out at a shared truck gate.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Trucks observed parked/staged along Zephyr St in multiple Street View captures (2022 and 2024) outside the gate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~95 acres derived from the perimeter box which includes the building, north drop yard, and the large south drop yard across the rail line.
